notes: Physical-test build: the new rising hillside cities (Hillside District, Valley Neighborhoods, Rolling Heights, Skyline Hill) - streets, blocks and neighborhoods that climb toward Ragnar.
Flatter launch arc: a normal pull now flies lower and shorter, into the rising city.
New red blood splats (stick to the ground and walls) and a small blood spray.
New fire, smoke, dust and explosion effects.
Several v13 targets that could not actually be reached were lowered or moved into reach. Grand Fortress and the other v13 cities are still there.
